blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
You just met the idea. Now do the lab: Sort the messy draft.

This lab can fail. Fail when: You still have steps on the explaining page, or a file is broken, or you cannot say which type is which.

Expected: Three clean files, each the right type. Quiz passed.

blocks.lead: Walk the cards below, in order, to Sort the messy draft.
blocks.intro: How to Sort the messy draft. Walk the cards in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Sort the messy draft
steps.body: This is the whole move. The next cards are the steps, in order.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Read these three jobs: (1) what a vase is, (2) how to recut stems, (3) vase sizes in centimetres.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Say which existing file (or new file) each job belongs in: concept, task, or reference.
